narrative: Material PL1__MDCB9B9C exhibits a smooth demand pattern with a coefficient of variation of 0.49 and 97.9% non-zero demand days, following a normal distribution. Lead time shows moderate stability (CV=0.37) with a mean of 4.05 days. The optimized policy recommends increasing safety stock from 539 to 2265 units and order quantity from 2589 to 9400 units, resulting in 70.9% cost savings ($5274.27 annually) while maintaining the 95.0% service level. The capacity-constrained order quantity of 9400 units, combined with safety stock of 2265 units, totals 11665 units, which is within the maximum storage limit of 11666 units.

research_insights.selection_rationale: Smooth near-continuous demand with CV=0.49 and 97.9% non-zero days is well-suited to a continuous-review (r,Q) policy. The EOQ balances ordering and holding costs; the reorder point provides statistically derived protection at the 95% service level.
research_insights.boundary_risk: Storage capacity is binding: unconstrained EOQ of 46,998 is capped to 9,400 by the 11,665.51-unit storage limit. This increases ordering frequency vs. unconstrained optimum but still yields 70.9% cost reduction over current SAP policy.
